metadata.name: Georgia 2030 (PLEXOS model reconstruction)
metadata.classification: study model reconstructed from the user-approved PLEXOS model 'BESS Research 800-1400'
limitations: Aggregated zonal/regional representation as in the PLEXOS model; not a unit-level model.
PLEXOS must-take renewables with dump energy are represented as curtailable renewables.
The regulating HPP is an energy-limited aggregate without a reservoir model.
TPP/Import is fixed to its hourly file; thermal costs are not modelled beyond VO&M 3.
